issue.title: Default sase bead list scales with the active set: 318 ms at 8x vs the 50 ms sase-1h8 A1 ceiling (ratio:list 5.1x)
issue.description:
The default `sase bead list` query (paged, active statuses) still scales with the size
of the active set. It misses epic sase-1h8's A1 criteria `ratio:list` (5.1x from 1x to
8x) and `abs:active-list` (318 ms at 8x vs a 50 ms ceiling).

Proposed by phase bead sase-1h8.14 (perf gate, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #3); routed here
by the sase-1h8 land agent.

Evidence: perf-gate sweep `sdd/plans/202610/perf_artifacts/bead_perf_gate.json` (core
pin 5c4033f6). Default list medians are 65.8 ms at 1x (25.8 ms in a clean window) and
318.1 ms at 8x. The paged query (`list_issue_page` -> core `bead_list_query` ->
`read_model::cached_list`) already reads only active rows. But it hydrates every one of
them, and the synthetic k-x corpus multiplies the active set too: per sase-1h8.12, 1x has
6,899 issues with 561 non-closed, and 8x has 55,516 issues with 4,196 non-closed. So this
is active-set scaling, not closed-history replay.

Decide and implement one of two approaches. Bounded serving: a default limit or
pagination for unbounded active lists, cheaper row encoding/hydration, or streaming
rows to the CLI. Or a principled gate change: hold the active set constant across
scales so `ratio:list` measures closed-history independence only. That needs explicit
owner approval, because the epic forbids silently loosening thresholds. Then drop
`ratio:list` and `abs:active-list` from the `bead-perf-scale-gate` `--gate-allow` list.

task_type_fields.impact:
`sase bead list` with no filters (the most common listing) gets slower as the number of
open/in-progress beads grows. At 8x it takes ~318 ms, against the 50 ms target.
task_type_fields.location: sase-core read_model::cached_list / bead_list_query; src/sase/bead/cli_query.py default list lane

issue.creation_reason: Perf gate sase-1h8.14 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #3) recorded this A1 miss; it needs a bounded-serving fix or an owner-approved gate definition, both outside the closed epic.
